item.title: Military violence never stopped - it has only intensified since the coup
item.description: Myanmar’s brief experiment with democracy had come to an abrupt halt when the military staged a coup d’état on 1 February 2021. Despite months of civilian resistance, there are no signs for immediate resolution and the impending question of who will represent Myanmar at the 76th UN General Assembly remains unanswered. item.title: The coup, the Spring Revolution, and a year of bravery
item.description: Today marks a year since the Myanmar military staged a coup and hijacked the country’s flawed yet significant strides towards democratization. More importantly, today also marks a year of bravery shown by the people of Myanmar in the face of violence, brutality, and injustice. For an entire year, the diverse people of Myanmar from all walks of life and across generations have been united in their tireless fight for democracy.
